recipeNotes: Bootstraps a workspace through the self-hosted installation.create endpoint, then sweeps the real RPC API (collections, documents incl. markdown export/import paths, search, users, teams, shares, events, views) plus the SPA shell. Runs all four services (web, websockets, worker, collaboration) in one cluster worker, so socket.io, bull queues and hocuspocus all participate.

phases.name: full
phases.detail: workspace bootstrap then the authenticated RPC surface (collections, documents, search, export)
